jobs_results.title: Project Manager | BPM | 100% remote
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Spain

Job Description

We are looking for the very Top Talent…and we would be delighted if you were to join our team!

More in details, UST is a multinational company based in North America, certified as a Top Employer company with over 29.000 employees all over the world and presence in more than 30 countries. We are leaders on digital technology services, and we provide large-scale technologic solutions to big companies. **

What are we looking for?**

We’re looking for a Project Manager who will be responsible for providing administrative, operational, and coordination assistance to the teams. The perfect candidate should have at least 5 years of working experience. This is a full remote position and for one of our most important clients of the banking sector in an international project. **

Key Responsibilities**
• Documentation Management
• Data Tracking and Reporting
• Administrative Support
• Resource Coordination
•... Financial Tracking
• Tool and Software Management
• Communication Facilitation
• Issue and Risk Tracking
• Process Adherence
• Meeting Coordination
• Training and Onboarding
• Quality Assurance
• Working with other IT Leads (SDS and BPM) and architects to ensuring technical solutions are aligned to Architecture strategy
• Ensuring BPM Squads are aligned to Product priorities
• Ensuring Technical, Solution, Security and Data Architecture approvals with support from E2E IT team if/when required.
• Providing release estimation based on current requirements and velocity of the team, calculate the targeted Go Live date alongside BPM Cross team

Mandatory Skills
• Strong organisational and multitasking skills to manage various tasks concurrently.
• Attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate records and documentation.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and project management tools.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with team members and stakeholders.
• Basic understanding of project management concepts and methodologies.
• Problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to handling challenges.
• Ability to work well in a collaborative team environment.
• Time management skills to meet deadlines and prioritise tasks effectively
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
• Experienced in Appian deliveries and an expert in software engineering and cloud
• Strong understanding of Operations processes
• Proven experience in multiple aspects of Project Delivery/Management using Agile Frameworks
• Strong communication and organisation skills, at both technical and business level
• Ability to define design, implementation, testing, deployment, and post-release support in an agile development environment
• Experience at executing engineering and release priorities successfully through strong leadership and communication

Skill Desirable
• Financial Services industry experience
• Some Spanish knowledge

Valuable and desirable: being entitled of Disability Certificate (at least 33% score) **

What can we offer?**
• 23 days of Annual Leave plus the 24th and 31st of December as discretionary days!
• Numerous benefits (Health Care Plan, teleworking compensation, Life and Accident Insurances).
• `Retribución Flexible´ Program: (Meals, Kinder Garden, Transport, online English lessons, Health Care Plan…)
• Free access to several training platforms
• Professional stability and career plans
• UST also, compensates referrals from which you could benefit when you refer professionals.
• The option to pick between 12 or 14 payments along the year.
• Real Work Life Balance measures (flexibility, WFH or remote work policy, compacted hours during summertime…)
• UST Club Platform discounts and gym Access discounts

If you would like to know more, don’t hesitate to apply and we’ll get in touch to fill you in detail. We are waiting for you!

This offer from "UST" has been enriched by Jobgether.com and got a 72% flex score

jobs_results.title: Data Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
BNP Paribas EMEA Finance employs 500 employees, of which more than 325 are based in Madrid. We manage more than 250 BNP Paribas entities from all over Europe, covering +60% of Group’s balance sheet and all group’s banking activities (Corporate & Investment Banking, Retail Banking, Personal Finance and other financial services activities…).

Our mission is to measure, control and explain all the financial indicators required to monitor accounting, tax, regulatory, liquidity, credit risk reporting and management result activities.

Data is a strategic asset for BNP Paribas, both to create value through and comply with stringent regulatory frameworks.

BNP Paribas focus is to maximize the value of data and gain competitive advantages across operational excellence, digital experience and innovation by

Improving decision-making processes, optimizing processes and industrializing use case with robust data, analytics and machine learning

Adopt new ways of working and new digital usage... while caring for user and employee data

Foster data enabled innovation to support –for instance- the sustainable transformation

Beside value creation, business and regulators increasingly ask for high quality standards, granular access, near real time availability, robust audit trails and advanced data infrastructures but also data protection and security practices are rapidly expanding and under scrutiny.

To meet this ambition Group Data Office’s mission is articulated around four pillars:  

Setting the Group data vision in alignment with the Businesses’ strategies and objectives  

Operationalizing this vision in close cooperation with IT and making data actionable to drive analytics and digital transformation  

Capitalizing on the steering and animation of the Business Lines and Functions CDOs community to strengthen the data culture within the Group  

Enforcing data governance policy including adherence to BCBS 239 and personal data privacy and protection regulations 

MISSION:

Your field of intervention will cover all aspects of the data strategy, ranging from data management issues, ESG-data supply change to data privacy and protection, AI and smart automation and deployment of other technological tools or the study of new fields of action.​

You will collaborate with Group Data Office experts, Business lines & Functions Data Offices and AI teams as well as other key partners across Marketing, IT, Legal, RISK, …

RESPONSIBILITIES:

As a project manager within the Data Strategy and Change team at the Group Data Office (GDO), you will contribute to the operationalization of the Data strategy, continuous regulatory compliance and data-driven value creation. In particular, you will:

- Steer data projects, oversee development and deployment of solutions, from design and planning to implementation within budget and deadlines, while ensuring quality of the deliverables

- Ensure alignment of business needs and IT developments while incorporating by design all applicable data frameworks, guidelines & good practices

-where applicable- Define and monitor key metrics and outcomes for strategic initiatives;

- Contribute to relevant Governance bodies and management presentations by drafting clear and concise material -including but not limited to-: project updates, decision-making support, working documents and meeting minutes

REQUIREMENTS:

Training:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration / Engineering / Finance / Data or Computer Science or related fields

• Ideally you have at least 3-5 years' of professional experience in project management, or consulting in the financial industry focused on the data and/or digital transformation, working through the full project lifecycle. Agile project management experience is a plus!

• Business skills -

- Solid project management experience, ability to manage cross functional/cross discipline teams and multiple tasks / work streams

- Experience developing and adapting a process and defining and monitoring performance indicators

- Data knowledge, including data quality, privacy, protection and security, and understanding of Artificial Intelligence and smart automation

- Knowledge of the BNP Paribas’ organization and understanding of Business/IT relationship

- Interest in new technologies and digital law

Tools and methodologies -

- Data preparation and visualization skills, leveraging either on MS Office (Excel, PPT) and associated tools (Think-cell)

- Experience with Project Management methodology

Languages:

• English:Fluent
SKILLS:

- Ability to anticipate business / strategic changes

- Expertise in understanding, explaining and leading change, by inspiring others and generating commitment

- Ability to facilitate a meeting, seminar, committee, training

​- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with ability to tailor approach to audience including “story telling”

- Proactivity, adaptability, problem solving and decision-making skills

- Creativity & Innovation

- Be results-, detail- and client-oriented

- Team player and strong collaboration mind-set

- Strong sense of organization

- Solid project management experience, ability to manage cross functional/cross discipline teams and multiple tasks / work streams

- Experience developing and adapting a process and defining and monitoring performance indicators

- Data knowledge, including data quality, privacy, protection and security, and understanding of Artificial Intelligence and smart automation

- Knowledge of the BNP Paribas’ organization and understanding of Business/IT relationship

- Interest in new technologies and digital law

Tools and methodologies -

- Data preparation and visualization skills, leveraging either on MS Office (Excel, PPT) and associated tools (Think-cell)

- Experience with Project Management methodology

• Data preparation and visualization skills, leveraging either on MS Office (Excel, PPT) and associated tools (Think-cell)

• Experience with Project Management methodology

• Abililty to anticipate business/strategic evolution

• Ability to understand, explain and support change

BENEFITS:

• Training programs, career plans and internal mobility opportunities, national and international thanks to our presence in different countries.

• Diversity and Inclusion Committee that ensures an inclusive work environment. In recent years, several employee communities have been created to organize diversity and inclusion awareness actions (PRIDE, We Generations and MixCity).

• Corporate volunteering program (1 Million Hours 2 Help) in which employees can dedicate time out of their working hours to volunteer activities.

• Flexible compensation plan

• Hybrid telecommuting model (50%)

• 31 vacation days

Diversity and Inclusion commitment

BNP Paribas Group in Spain is an equal opportunity employer and proud to provide equal employment opportunity to all job seekers. We are actively committed to ensuring that no individual is discriminated against on the grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership status, pregnancy and maternity/paternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. Equity and diversity are at the core of our recruitment policy because we believe that they foster creativity and efficiency, which in turn increase performance and productivity. We strive to reflect the society we live in, while keeping with the image of our clients

jobs_results.title: SAP Testing Senior Project Manager
jobs_results.via: via Your Career Journey With Nestlé | Nestlé Global - Nestlé
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a SAP Testing Senior Project Manager to be part of our IT Platforms Department.

Position Snapshot
• Location: Nestlé Global Tech Hub in Barcelona, Spain
• Type of Contract: Permanent
• Stream: IT Platforms
• Type of work: Hybrid
• Work Language: Fluent Business English
• Grade: G1

The role

In this position, you will bring deep expertise and knowledge to the SAP Landscape platform group team. As an SAP Testing Senior Project Manager, you will be responsible for guiding and promoting the proper testing framework & tools amongst the regional testing leads, coaching and supporting functional experts in the testing of the S/4HANA program and other technical projects.

You will work closely with the SAP Landscape team and suppliers to ensure that the manual regression testing milestones are achieved in time and with the quality standards agreed. Also, you will be responsible for supervising the testing framework and tools as well as the implementation within the scope... agreed, owning the overall testing strategy and governance.

What you’ll do

• Make recommendations on how to improve the effectiveness, efficiency, and delivery of testing services through use of (emerging) technology and technical methods and methodologies.

• Drive S/4 HANA technical projects, leading the testing teams.

• Participate in the development of and/or review of S/4 HANA testing strategy, documentation, and methods.

• Liaise closely with vendors for proof of concepts of new tools available in the market related to manual and automated testing.

• Work with IS/IT Innovation managers, Platform managers, Product Stream Operations Managers and Business Analysts as required to ensure S/4 HANA testing can be covered.

We offer you

We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.
• Great benefits including competitive salary and a comprehensive social benefits package. We have one of the most competitive pension plans on the market, as well as flexible remuneration with tax advantages: health insurance, restaurant card, mobility plan, etc.
• Personal and professional growth through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.
• Hybrid working environment with flexible working scheme. Our state-of-the-art campus is dog friendly and equipped with a medical center, canteen and areas to co-create network and chill!
• Recreation activities such as yoga, Zumba, etc. and a wide range of volunteering activities.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, system analysis or a related study, or equivalent experience

• Strong stakeholder management

• 10+ years in IT field, focusing on S/4 HANA projects, including experience in SAP testing, and managing testing tools such as Solution Manager and Azure DevOps.

• Good understanding of test automation platforms.

• Strong background in SAP project management

• Thorough understanding of software development lifecycle, specifically automated quality assurance processes

Bonus points if you:

• Have excellent analytical and technical skills.

• Have experience with effective communication at different levels in the organization and in English.

• Have experience working in a global environment and with virtual teams.

About the IT Hub

At Nestlé IT, we are a diverse, global team of IT professionals in the biggest health, nutrition and wellness company of the world. We strive to create an environment where people are valued for who they are. We innovate every day through future ready technologies to create opportunities for Nestlé to delight consumers, customers and employees alike. We collaborate with partners around the world to deliver tangible value at global scale. We continuously work to develop our people to be future ready.

About Nestlé

We are Nestlé, the largest food and beverage company in the world, with a presence in more than 185 countries. With net sales of CHF 94.4 billion in 2022, the company has over 291,000 employees and 418 factories in 85 countries. Our values are based on respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity, and respect for our future. Nestlé is dedicated to offering high-quality food and beverage products and services that contribute to the nutrition, health, and well-being of people, pets, and the planet. Additionally, it is committed to being a leading company in sustainability and achieving net zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050. Want to learn more? Visit us at: www.nestle.com

We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.

Step outside your comfort zone; share your ideas, way of thinking and working to make a difference to the world, every single day. You own a piece of the action – make it count.

Join Nestlé’s IT Hub #beaforceforgood

How we will proceed: You send us your CV → We contact relevant applicants → Interviews → Feedback → Job Offer communication to the Finalist → First working day

jobs_results.title: Agile Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Location & work modality: Rubí / Barcelona Hybrid #LI-Hybrid

Start: ASAP

Type of Contract: Full Time / Permanent

About Submer

The best way to introduce you to Submer is undoubtedly through our values: Sustainable, Unique, Bold, Making Sense, Empathetic and Reliable. If these resonate with you we're sure you will find your place here in no time.

At Submer, we believe that our digital world can be more sustainable, more efficient and more environmentally friendly. Submer is solving the biggest problems of datacenter, supercomputer, hyperscale and edge applications to make that future possible.

Our multinational talented team has a huge passion in reducing IT environmental footprint and expertise in datacenter design and day-to-day operations. We’re scaling our team and operations worldwide to meet growing international demand.

What impact you will have

As an Agile Project Manager experienced Scrum Master adept at driving Agile methodologies and nurturing synergistic... collaboration within diverse, cross-functional teams. The role entails overseeing the development of two hardware products alongside a software team, ensuring seamless integration across both domains. Proficient in identifying and resolving impediments, the Scrum Master is instrumental in streamlining processes to enhance project delivery efficiency.

What you’ll do:
• Facilitate Scrum events (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospective) ensuring active participation and adherence to the Scrum process.
• Practice servant leadership by empowering and supporting the Scrum Team to self-organize and achieve their goals while shielding them from external distractions and impediments.
• Identify and remove blockers hindering the team's progress, collaborating with stakeholders to resolve organizational issues impacting the team.
• Coach team members and the organization on agile principles and Scrum practices, promoting collaboration among team members, stakeholders, and other Scrum roles.
• Work closely with Product Owners and stakeholders to ensure clear communication and alignment on project goals.
• Facilitate regular retrospectives to reflect on processes and identify opportunities for improvement, implementing new practices to enhance team efficiency.
• Assist the team in establishing and monitoring relevant metrics to track performance and progress, providing insights through metrics such as burndown charts and velocity.
• Communicate with internal and external stakeholders to gather project requirements, provide updates, and manage expectations, acting as the main point of contact between the project team and stakeholders.
• Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including plans, reports, and status updates, and generate regular progress reports for stakeholders and leadership.

What you’ll need:
• Bachelor's degree in Business administration, Project Management, or a related field such as Engineering (master’s preferred).
• Proven experience as a Scrum Master in hardware product development (minimum 5 years).
• Proficiency in Jira.
• Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
• Outstanding organizational and multitasking capabilities.
• Native English is required, and good working knowledge of Spanish is preferred (other languages are a plus).
• Proactive self-starter with clear internal and external communication skills.
• Strong critical thinking skills.

What we offer
• Attractive compensation package reflecting your expertise and experience.
• Restaurant Pass.
• Private Health Insurance.
• A healthy work environment with fresh fruits to energise and an on-site gym for active breaks.
• A great work environment characterised by friendliness, international diversity, flexibility, and a hybrid-friendly approach.
• You'll be part of a fast-growing scale-up with a mission to make a positive impact, offering an exciting career evolution.

Our Inclusive Responsibility

Submer is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected category under applicable law

Our multinational talented team has a huge passion in reducing IT environmental footprint and expertise in datacenter design and day-to-day operations. We’re scaling our team and operations worldwide to meet growing international demand.

What impact you will have

As an Agile Project Manager experienced Scrum Master adept at driving Agile methodologies and nurturing synergistic... collaboration within diverse, cross-functional teams. The role entails overseeing the development of two hardware products alongside a software team, ensuring seamless integration across both domains. Proficient in identifying and resolving impediments, the Scrum Master is instrumental in streamlining processes to enhance project delivery efficiency.

What you’ll do:
• Facilitate Scrum events (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospective) ensuring active participation and adherence to the Scrum process.
• Practice servant leadership by empowering and supporting the Scrum Team to self-organize and achieve their goals while shielding them from external distractions and impediments.
• Identify and remove blockers hindering the team's progress, collaborating with stakeholders to resolve organizational issues impacting the team.
• Coach team members and the organization on agile principles and Scrum practices, promoting collaboration among team members, stakeholders, and other Scrum roles.
• Work closely with Product Owners and stakeholders to ensure clear communication and alignment on project goals.
• Facilitate regular retrospectives to reflect on processes and identify opportunities for improvement, implementing new practices to enhance team efficiency.
• Assist the team in establishing and monitoring relevant metrics to track performance and progress, providing insights through metrics such as burndown charts and velocity.
• Communicate with internal and external stakeholders to gather project requirements, provide updates, and manage expectations, acting as the main point of contact between the project team and stakeholders.
• Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including plans, reports, and status updates, and generate regular progress reports for stakeholders and leadership.

What you’ll need:
• Bachelor's degree in Business administration, Project Management, or a related field such as Engineering (master’s preferred).
• Proven experience as a Scrum Master in hardware product development (minimum 5 years).
• Proficiency in Jira.
• Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
• Outstanding organizational and multitasking capabilities.
• Native English is required, and good working knowledge of Spanish is preferred (other languages are a plus).
• Proactive self-starter with clear internal and external communication skills.
• Strong critical thinking skills.

What we offer
• Attractive compensation package reflecting your expertise and experience.
• Restaurant Pass.
• Private Health Insurance.
• A healthy work environment with fresh fruits to energise and an on-site gym for active breaks.
• A great work environment characterised by friendliness, international diversity, flexibility, and a hybrid-friendly approach.
• You'll be part of a fast-growing scale-up with a mission to make a positive impact, offering an exciting career evolution.

Our Inclusive Responsibility

Submer is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected category under applicable law

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
We are selecting a Project Manager for Cummins Spain, San Fernando de Henares. Hybrid work model, travelling 60%, relocation is not eligible. English high level (C1 Cambridge equivalent) is a MUST. In this role, you will make an impact in some of the following ways: - Identifying project stakeholders, risks, work scope, budget and schedule expectations - Developing Project Plans - Reporting to both internal and external stakeholders, including Company Leaders, the status of his/her projects: time schedule, costs vs. Budget, risks, technical issues, etc - Coordinating with subject matter experts to ensure that the project execution plan has correctly identified the required resources, tools, and methodology. - Understanding project activities and interdependencies in order to support the development of an accurate budget and schedule, then managing project execution accordingly. - Understanding contractual terms and conditions - Serving as the primary client interface - Supporting the... establishment of effective working relationships, both within the project team and between the project team and external stakeholders. Measuring project performance, forecasting outcomes and, when necessary, developing proactive course corrections - Ensuring that the project team is adhering to applicable Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) and Quality Management, and Projects Systems - From the sales process, identifying and register the Projects’ risks, monitoring these risks while using creativity and out-of-the-box thinking to propose mitigation

Compensation Class

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Purpose of Job
Integrating the project team, the project manager is responsible to manage and lead the team responsible for the technical design and construction of its area of responsibility and to liaise with EPCm companies, equipment manufacturers and contractors to successfully implement new assets and facilities until commissioning and/or handover, in line with the expectations of the stakeholders.

Strategic focus
RBM’s strategic growth roadmap aims to align its production capacity in the future with market demand in the supply rechargeable battery materials.

In this context, a global program of investment projects has been identified, requiring additional resources of project managers to take the lead in the execution of strategic and complex investments in an international context and manage the teams involved, including external engineering and construction companies.

By supporting the above plan, the Project Manager is responsible for the team that designs and constructs... manufacturing facilities and related structures, determines facility specifications, material resources, structural designs and construction & assembly set ups.

The Project Manager is a key role in expansion projects to provide more capacity to our three main types of production steps, Leaching and Refining, Precursor and Cathode Active Materials, and it is expected a great contribution for the resolution of technical problems and suggestions for installation improvements to meet process requirements

Main responsibilities
• Execute the project within the agreed scope, planning and budget
• Guarantee alignment of the process and technological development
• Assure that all process and operations related aspects are covered
• Assure that technical requirements and capacity are met
• Assure the knowledge transfer into the operational organization
• Define and follow up the progress of all the work packages required for theexecution of the project
• Assure control and follow-up of all aspects of the project by regular meetings andreporting
• Timely detect roadblocks and take corrective action to overcome them
• Report progress of the project to the program director
• Manages risk, change of scope, business case and end of phase reporting
• Clear and transparent communication to all stakeholders
• Gather the lessons learned during the course of the project
• Prepare, revise and approve technical documentation for the design phases of projects, guaranteeing that standards, guidelines, best available, safe and costeffective solutions are considered.
• Ensure that project documents are complete and optimal for a competitive andfair tender process.
• Support the procurement phase of specific components and works, screeningfrom bids to good reception confirmation in support of the project management.
• Control costs during execution of projects.
• Supervise the construction, installation and commissioning of assigned projects,within its area of responsibility.
• Work with other Engineering teams, integrating the work with other specialtiesinto the final project solution, assuring user deadlines are met and without unexpected delays in production.
• Execute all assigned tasks, planning and delivering on time, safely, efficiently,reliably and in a cost-effective manner.
• Make quality and timely decisions within the Engineering tasks under his/her responsibility
• Gather relevant data to inform the decision makers regarding complex issues
• Propose improvements (procedures, organizational, new technologies, capex,productivity) as appropriate.
• Capture user feedback and lessons learned for future projects.
• Collaborates in internal and external audits.
• Carry out assigned tasks and duties in a safe manner, in accordance withinstructions, and to comply with environmental, health & safety rules/procedures,regulations and codes of practice.
• Manage vendors & contractors onsite, analyze the potential risk and recommendactions to mitigate the problems from construction (EHS, manpower, logistics …).
• Perform or support commissioning of the equipment before handing over to the Process team, support process team during the internal qualification
• Perform engineering and technical support to the projects when needed, undertaking any additional tasks commensurate with the role as and when required.

Key Parameters
• Participating in projects of an average, but not limited to, 25 to 50m€
• Working at sites reporting to RBM business unit and integrating teams up to 20 engineers
• May supervise up to 10 technicians and less experience engineers
• May work abroad for certain periods of time, in other RBM sites or at vendor facilities

Interfaces
• Project Managers have main interface so Internally with process engineers, procurement, operations, supply chain, quality, maintenance and EHS
• Externally with contractors and vendors, engineering partners and equip, manufacturers

Required Profile
• University degree, or equivalent qualification, in Engineering, preferably in Mechanical,Chemical, Electrical, Instrumentation/Automation
• Technical experience and/or background in the execution of engineering projects (ofspecialties above mentioned)
• Relevant experience and understanding in the execution of industrial projects in operationalenvironments
• Knowledge of design software (e.g. AutoCad)
• Knowledge of EHS standards, industry good practices and legal requirements applicable tothe specialty of focus
• Competent (written and verbal) English and Spanish
• Computer literate with good working knowledge of the MS Office package
• Must have the Knowledge, Experience and Skills to conduct their tasks in accordance with the rules and procedures set down.

Personal Skills
• Organized
• Open minded
• Team worker
• Result oriented
• Positive and committed to work autonomously
• Capable to work in matrix organizations, reporting to multiple supervisors
• Problem solver
• Flexible to work in ambiguous situations with limited supervision
• Supporting others with less experience
• Good communication and interpersonal skills

With over 90 years' combined experience, NES Fircroft (NES) is proud to be the world's leading engineering staffing provider spanning the Oil & Gas, Power & Renewables, Chemicals, Construction & Infrastructure, Life Sciences, Mining and Manufacturing sectors worldwide. With more than 80 offices in 45 countries, we are able to provide our clients with the engineering and technical expertise they need, wherever and whenever it is needed. We offer contractors far more than a traditional recruitment service, supporting with everything from securing visas and work permits, to providing market-leading benefits packages and accommodation, ensuring they are safely and compliantly able to support our clients

jobs_results.title: Agile Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
About Liferay

Liferay, Inc. is a uniquely profitable B2B enterprise software company with 1,200+ fiery-eyed employees all across Europe, the Americas, the Middle East, Asia, and Africa. As a renowned provider of enterprise open source technologies, we have been recognized by Gartner for empowering businesses around the world to solve complex digital challenges. Liferay Experience Cloud is an all-in-one solution that unites our Liferay DXP and cloud platform capabilities with built-in analytics and B2B commerce functionality, reducing the time to market and allowing for accelerated innovation - serving notable customers across the globe such as Airbus, US Bank, Honda, and Desjardins.

But we don’t just make awesome software, we are also fueled by a greater-than-profit vision. By building a vibrant business, making technology useful, and investing in communities, we make it possible for people to reach their full potential to serve others. We give our employees five days off to... volunteer at charities they’re excited about, and Liferay donates 10% of our profits to charities around the world. Oh, we’re also self-funded which gives us the freedom to work on whatever we think brings the most value to customers and communities in the long run!

About You and this Role

Do you have enough knowledge and experience about Kanban and Scrum to know how and when to apply it and when not to? Is communication one of your strengths? Do you like to go deeper on issues and find root causes? Do you have the abilities to know how to measure progress objectively and know when to celebrate the achievements? Are you motivated and feel challenged to work in a multi-cultural and distributed team?

If the answer to these questions is yes, then this is your role! Your main purpose will be to serve and help engineers building awesome products that our customers love, inspired by the principles of Lean, Agile and Servant Leadership.

Within Product Teams, you’ll be working to…
• Drive to get things done by leading the efficient delivery of one or several teams for rolling releases
• Ensure project scope is defined and teams are committed to deliver value in a timely manner.
• Follow up the plan frequently, make sure the right priorities are in place and make adjustments accordingly.
• Manage risks and dependencies with transparency and special focus on solving issues.
• Contribute to creating an environment which fosters autonomous, self-organizing, empowered and continuously improving teams.
• Define, gather and analyze metrics to drive decision-making. Determine when a metric is needed and when it’s no longer useful.
• Help high-performance teams and individuals to grow, challenge them to improve further and help them track progress and clear any roadblock
• Contribute to inter-team communication using the tools available (email, announcements, forums, slack, JIRA, GitHub, wiki....) or introducing new tools. Ability to learn and master new tools fast to serve the needs of the development teams.
• Actively try to identify waste and areas of improvement within each team.
• Release planning and coordination within engineering teams.

Global & Across-teams, your focus will be…
• Apply our knowledge to foster collaboration and coordination among teams within Engineering or outside.
• Act as a facilitator to ensure global processes are adopted by the teams.
• Act as connectors and communicators to ensure information is available to everyone.

As a member of the project management department, you will have to…
• Contribute with your knowledge, experience and ideas to the department.
• Be proactive! Learn, fail and experiment.

Required Qualifications
• +4 years of Project Manager experience.
• Knowledgeable in technology: Computer Science or Engineering degree is a plus or equivalent level of demonstrated knowledge
• Outstanding verbal and written communication skills in Spanish and English.
• Experience applying agile and/or lean project management techniques in complex projects and distributed teams
• Proven ability to lead and manage large, complex enterprise-level projects and ensure objectives, goals, and commitments are met
• Strong analytical, planning, and organizational skills with an ability to manage competing demands
• Expert knowledge and experience in Agile/Lean principles and practices.
• Proactivity, joy for learning and facing new challenges.
• Passion about continuous improvement and problem-solving.

Preferred Qualifications
• Knowledge of content management systems and other portal platforms.
• Knowledge of project management tools: JIRA, Basecamp...
• Training skills.
• Communication skills, teamwork, dynamism, empathy, social commitment and sense of humor.
• Understanding of how Open Source projects work.

What We Offer
• Competitive salary according to qualifications and experience
• 5 additional perks (Health Care Plan, Transport Card/Office Parking Space/Voucher, Food Card, Gym Allowance…)
• English lessons (2 hours/week)
• Opportunities to take responsibility, grow professionally, and Stay Nerdy
• A positive and collaborative work culture
• Check out what employees say about us on Glassdoor
• Working at a leading open-source company
• Employee Volunteer Program, including 5 days/year of voluntary service + 500€/year to collaborate to the charity of your choice

Equal Opportunities Employer - Statement

Liferay is committed to the equal treatment of all candidates, customers and employees and to fostering a culture of dignity at work. Our operating procedure provides for equal opportunities in recruitment and employment with the aim to eliminate discrimination against any job applicant or employee on the basis of race, age, sexual orientation, gender, religion or beliefs, marital or civil partnerships status, family or dependency status, disability, pregnancy and maternity or membership of a traveling community

jobs_results.description:
Lear For You

We work hard for the people who work for us. We champion our teams. We foster collaboration, inclusion, respect and excellence. What we are trying to say is we want to be more for you.

We are your path to a better career, a better future, and a better you.

Our teams have invented groundbreaking technologies, flawlessly manufactured millions of products and earned a long list of awards. Year after year, we are one of the World's Most Admired Companies.

Our teams are the secret to our success. They are empowered, inventive and inclusive. Passionate about their craft. Driven to succeed. Because we all understand that we must work together to win.

Are you ready for a better career? A better future?

We're Lear For You.

As a Project Manager based in Porriño (Spain) you will lead the delivery of multiple programs for the Structure division. You will lead global cross-functional teams that include sales, engineering, manufacturing, finance, quality and purchasing. You will... be responsible for program timeline development, documentation and execution ensuring scope, quality, timing and cost objectives are met.

Responsibilities:

• Lead cross-functional teams to plan and flawlessly execute programs that exceed both customer and internal customer expectations

• Taking responsibility for the program to ensure it is delivered on time, within budget, within approved profitability and required quality standards

• Planning and execution of all activities in accordance with milestones defined by the customer

• Management of product changes according to flexibility and costs defined/agreed with Engineering and Sales

• Identification of possible risks and critical points and application of necessary corrective measures by escalation in order to obtain the necessary support

Requirements:

• Higher education in engineering

• Experience working in the automotive industry and preferably in the field of mechanics

• At least 5 years of project management experience leading cross-functional teams both local and in highly dynamic environments

• Excellent communication skills

• Fluent in English and Spanish, French is an advantage

• Proactive, responsible, can-do attitude person and stress-resilient

• Identification of possible risks and critical points and application of necessary corrective measures by escalation in order to obtain the necessary support

Requirements:

• Higher education in engineering

• Experience working in the automotive industry and preferably in the field of mechanics

• At least 5 years of project management experience leading cross-functional teams both local and in highly dynamic environments

• Excellent communication skills

• Fluent in English and Spanish, French is an advantage

• Proactive, responsible, can-do attitude person and stress-resilient

jobs_results.description:
About Thunes

Thunes is a global, fast-growing, and innovative Fintech scale-up that uses technology to disrupt and transform the existing financial system.
We have a strong Mission: to create a better global payments network, and a great Purpose: to connect the world to economic opportunities and address systemic inequality when it comes to financial services.
We are proud to power payments for the world’s fastest-growing businesses and work with some of the amazing global brands - from Gig Economy giants such as Uber and Deliveroo and Southeast Asia's super-app Grab, to global Fintech leaders such as PayPal and Remitly.
Our Products help to drastically simplify the Payment integration experience for our customers: with a single, simple connection, businesses and consumers can send payments to – and get paid in – every corner of the world. Instantly.
Thunes is headquartered in Singapore with regional offices in London, Barcelona, Paris, Beijing, Shanghai, Miami, Dubai, Nairobi... Manila, Hong Kong and San Francisco!

Context of the role

We’re looking for a Technical Project Manager to be an integral part of our Solutions Delivery Team.
As part of the Solution Delivery team, this role will bring you great opportunities to work on various projects, collaborating with a diverse range of partners and teams.
The Solution Delivery team is responsible for supporting the integration of partners within the Thunes Cross-Border Payment platform. Processing millions of transactions per month and interconnecting hundreds of partners from all around the world, Thunes is continuously growing its coverage and footprint in the industry. A career with Thunes provides invaluable experience in an exciting and rapidly expanding market and an opportunity to be part of a truly global company with various offices worldwide and a workforce that includes dozens of different nationalities.

Qualities you would find in our Payment Integration Team
• Strong Team Spirit - Ability to learn lots of things and happy to help and each other
• Empowerment - Initiatives to build tools and propose solutions that adds value to the business
• Ownership - End to end ownership of project management in continuous integration from concept to deployment

Responsibilities:

We’re looking for a highly driven, self-motivated, technically hands-on person who is truly excited about having a meaningful impact within the company and for our partners.
In this role, you will combine a startup mindset with the scale of an industry leader. Working with different types of partners you must remain agile and always adapt your process and mindset to the partner you are dealing with.

In this role you will.
• Proactively scope the technical solution required to address customer requirements, assesses customers’ met and unmet needs, and recommends solutions that optimize value for both the customer and Thunes.
• Coordinates closely with sales, sales support, and delivery teams to align solution design with customers’ business requirements
• Secure from customer technical resource commitments needed to ensure a deal’s “technical close.”
• Lead and drive the partner integration from the analysis phase though the integration design until go live and post-delivery monitoring
• Support existing partners that are already integrated to the platform with their daily challenges and expansion plans
• Provide solutions and contribute to proof of concepts outside of the box for some special projects
• Drive improvements for internal monitoring, reporting and operational tools and processes
• Provides training to the sales team in order to enhance their product knowledge, technical acumen, and technical sales skills

To stand out you will:
• Be customer facing – you will have a close relationship with our partners and business development teams to expand our coverage and services
• Work closely with different internal teams to understand and support operational processes and new solutions
• Always keep a solution mindset and look for improvements that you can bring to the organization
• Work with an agile and expanding team, offering mentoring, training and possibly management to junior members
• Participate in continuous integration, managing updates from concept to deployment
• Opportunistically pursues additional business development opportunities within customer firms

Skills & Qualifications:
• Prior & proven min. ~3 years of experience in a technical project management (API / Integrations) or solutions delivery role with external stakeholders
• Experience in a B2B company supporting partners on a technical solution or service
• Experience working and strong interest in the Fintech and/or Payment Industry and market innovations
• Experience working and integrating with APIs over IP (REST, Json XML, Web Services, …)
• Experience working in an Agile environment – Jira management is a plus
• Demonstrate motivation to learn new skills and technologies
• Ability to work effectively, multi-task, agile and take responsibility in challenging situations
• Strong customer focused and result oriented mindset
• Independent and proactive - willing to get things done
• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
• Excellent interpersonal skills, be creative, friendly and solution-oriented with customers and colleagues
• Fluency in English, other European or African languages are a plus.

Sound like you? Apply now
